atoms.text: Vincent van Gogh was an amazing painter. He was born in 1853 in the Netherlands. In a decade, he created about 2,100 pieces of art, including around 860 oil paintings, most of which he created in the last two years of his life. Although he is one of the world’s most famous artists today, his art wasn’t appreciated until after he died at the age of 37 in 1890.

atoms.a: What was Vincent van Gogh’s job?
How is Vincent van Gogh seen today?

atoms.text: His early works, mostly still lifes and depictions of peasant workers, are very different from the vivid colour present in his later work. Van Gogh’s painting style began to change in 1886 when he moved to Paris, where he met avant-garde artists. His colours became bolder, his brushstrokes became more dramatic and expressive, and he expanded his subject matter to include things like sunflowers and olive trees. By the time he came back from the South of France in 1888, his new expressionist style was fully developed.

hint.label: Glossary
hint.text:
Something or someone is avant-garde when using new and experimental ideas.

Expressionism was an artistic movement that involved painting the real world in a twisted or warped way for emotional effect.
